verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for an authenticator or password manager, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only agent-readable documentation (llms.txt, markdown mirrors), which is adjacent docs plumbing rather than natural-language control of the product. The probe also records the llms.txt declaring 'Public API: None', and no evidence shows any natural-language command interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
